description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340015882024 BRACKET,MOUNTING: Line 0001 Qty 32 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0256 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
